actor: Codex SI agent; no human panel or independent linguistic approval
scope: Headword-level screening of all 3057 baseline tokens, not an exhaustive review of every dictionary sense or generated combination
purpose: An experimental general-display vocabulary that avoids conspicuous adult, violent, criminal, derogatory and severe-trauma headwords
default: no-headword-flag; eligible for experiment, not certified harmless
retained: Ordinary negative emotions, neutral medical and anatomical terms, identity, gender, religion, nationality and political affiliation are not inherently offensive and are not automatic exclusions. Phrase combinations and slang may remain sensitive.

adult-sexual.reason: Conspicuous adult sexual meaning or ambiguous standalone sexual morpheme in an unattended general-display setting

violence-coercion.reason: Headword directly evokes violence, coercion, weapons or violent conflict

crime-abuse.reason: Direct criminal, abusive or deceptive action; context preference rather than a moral judgement on all senses

death-severe-trauma.reason: Conspicuous death, self-harm, severe injury, disaster or severe disease headword

substances.reason: Alcohol, tobacco or illicit-drug reference unsuitable for some school or family display contexts

derogatory-body-function.reason: Headword commonly used as an insult, humiliation, blunt bodily function or sensitive relationship accusation

limitations: Single agent assessment with possible omissions and bias
No measured human response or regional familiarity
